question: The Dachigam National Park is best known as the home of the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hangul**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Dachigam National Park, located in Jammu and Kashmir, India, is renowned for being the habitat of the **hangul**, also known as the Kashmir stag.
 
• The hangul is a **critically endangered species** and is the only surviving species of the Red Deer family in India.
 
• The park provides a crucial sanctuary for the hangul, which faces threats from habitat destruction, poaching, and human encroachment.
 
• Conservation efforts are ongoing to protect and increase the population of hangul in Dachigam National Park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dachigam National Park**

 
 
• Established in 1910, the park covers an area of approximately 141 square kilometers.
 
• It is divided into two parts: the Lower Dachigam and Upper Dachigam, each with distinct flora and fauna.
 
• The park's altitude ranges from 5,500 feet to 14,000 feet above sea level, offering diverse habitats.
 
 
 
• **Hangul Conservation**
 
 
• Several conservation projects, including captive breeding and habitat restoration, have been initiated to save the hangul.
 
• The Wildlife Institute of India and the Jammu and Kashmir Wildlife Department are actively involved in these efforts.
 
• Winter feeding programs and anti-poaching measures are crucial components of the conservation strategy.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity in Dachigam**
 
 
• Besides the hangul, the park is home to species such as the Himalayan black bear, musk deer, and various bird species.
 
• The flora includes a mix of coniferous forests, alpine pastures, and meadows, supporting a rich ecosystem.
 
• The park also features several streams and lakes, adding to its ecological diversity.
 
 
 
• **Tourism and Accessibility**
 
 
• Dachigam National Park is accessible from Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Tourists can visit the park throughout the year, with the best time being from April to October.
 
• Guided tours and trekking are popular activities for visitors to explore the park's natural beauty.
